# YOHANE THE PARHELION -BLAZE in the DEEPBLUE-

## Where is the options page?

You can read through all the options and generate a YAML [here](../player-options).

## What does randomization do to this game?
Item which the player would normally collect throughout the game have been moved around and the final boss is now locked behing defeating all 8 
main bosses instead of rescuing all ally characters.

## What items and locations get randomized?
All ally characters, their upgrades and important movement upgrades have been randomized, on top of that, materials with limited amounts 
available have also been added to the item pool. All chests and boss defeats are locations, and rescuing an ally is another check.

## What does another world's item look like in YOHANE THE PARHELION -BLAZE in the DEEPBLUE-?
Any items in the game are unchanged (subject to change).

# YOHANE THE PARHELION -BLAZE in the DEEPBLUE- Setup Guide

## Required Software

- [Archipelago](https://github.com/ArchipelagoMW/Archipelago/releases)
- [YOHANE THE PARHELION -BLAZE in the DEEPBLUE- on Steam](https://store.steampowered.com/app/2404370/YOHANE_THE_PARHELION_BLAZE_in_the_DEEPBLUE/)

## Connecting to the Archipelago Server
Install the mod loader from https://github.com/SilicDev/YohaneBIDModLoader/releases/latest and the AP mod
from https://github.com/SilicDev/YohaneAPMod/releases/latest . Follow the setup instructions on both and configure your connection in
`.mods/YohaneAPMod/config.ini`. The game should automatically connect once you load into a save file.

### Old: Python client
With the game open, open the **YOHANE THE PARHELION -BLAZE in the DEEPBLUE- Client** from the Launcher and connect it to the Archipelago server.
